integrity: The known induced-star characterization is credited to existing literature. The resource decomposition, generating function, extremal parity bound and maximum-set counts are justified by self-contained arguments. No formal or independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to two-coordinate rook graphs; the size enumerator counts labelled rows and columns. Computational checks are finite; independent mathematical validation and complete bibliographic priority checking have not been performed.
title: Edge-open-packing polynomial and a parity gap for rook graphs
